from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted legal classification facts for a single judicial document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or name of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    primary_legal_type: str | None = Field(description="The main type of proceeding: '民事', '刑事', '行政', or '执行'")
    sub_dispute_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal subject matter or cause of action (e.g., '产品责任', '房屋拆迁', '行政处罚', '行政登记', '行政许可', '司法行政管理')")
    is_execution_case: bool = Field(description="True if the document relates to an enforcement/execution proceeding")
    execution_sub_type: str | None = Field(description="For execution cases, the nature of execution: '民事', '行政', or '其他'")
    text_evidence_quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt from the text supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[DocumentCase]
